_meta.dropped_why: an element with no rung a live run passed would be DERIVED by the container anyway (consult answers unknown-control, which is the tri-state's own answer, not a miss); shipping it costs bytes and vouches for nothing
_meta.ranking_note: find_control breaks a same-label tie on the SUM of n_verified over the element's whole ladder. Here that sum is over the verified rungs only, so an element carrying a rung with n_verified > 0 whose last_verdict is a failure ranks lower against this pack than against the full store. Stated, not silent; regenerate the pack to re-sync.
